content:
Bookmarks, Evolved

Linkwarden helps you collect, read, annotate, and fully preserve what matters, all in one place.

Everything you need for your bookmarks

Full-page preservation

Unlike traditional bookmarks that often break or vanish, Linkwarden backs up every page in multiple formats, including full HTML content, ensuring you always have access to the original content.

Read more

Read & Annotate

View your saved articles and bookmarks in our dedicated reader view where you can make adjustments to the font style, highlight text, and add annotations effortlessly.

Read more

Automatic Organization

With AI-powered tagging and search filters, Linkwarden automatically categorizes your bookmarks so you can find exactly what you need in seconds.

Read more

Sharing & Collaboration

Invite friends or teammates to contribute to your collections, ideal for research, content planning, or shared interests, and easily share them with the public.

Read more

Open Source Means Transparency

Linkwarden's source code is fully public, giving you visibility into how it works and confidence in how your data is handled.
